note: Which numbered sections of each rule document a pipeline stage receives. Section numbers refer to the headings in the three rule documents. DRAFT: needs the rule owner's sign-off and a before/after quality check on saved requests. If a section number is missing from a document (for example after it is edited), that whole document is sent in full for the stage and a warning is logged, so a profile can never silently drop rules. Stages not listed (strategy, reference, extract, revise) use no rule documents.
